items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: we had lunch with the late Queen Alia (PHONETIC) and Princess

ctx.x: Would you just play for an hour or something?

We would play 45-minute concert and take a little intermission and take another 45 minutes. Very easy. Oh, very easy, but the people absolutely just went wild. Of course, Louie Armstrong and Duke had been going over there for a long time. Louie Armstrong was the first one to start going over. Then from Pakistan, we went to Amman, Jordan, and we had lunch with the late Queen Alia (PHONETIC) and Princess --
Did you meet Hussein, King Hussein?
